title: Where AI did and didn't help in a shipped 3D golf game: code, physics, course pipeline, art, voice
author: nils116
selftext:
I'm Nils, solo dev. Worldwide Golf, a 3D golf game for iPhone, went live yesterday. Got lucky because the AI came up with a pretty catchy Style & Punch Line (pure golf in your pocket). 
    

https://i.redd.it/rprg0wtlft2i1.gif

Here's an honest map of what AI did in it, by area:  
  
Code (Claude Code): All of \~100k lines of Swift. SwiftUI app, RealityKit rendering, Game Center, StoreKit, localisation into five languages. Worked best with a strict rules file per repo, small reviewable steps and tests for everything. 2 Claude Premium Accounts did the whole job within roughly 8 weeks  
  
Physics (Claude, tuned by me): our own golf simulation. Claude wrote it against TrackMan tour averages; I tuned the feel by playing. Each rules version is frozen by tests so scores stay comparable. Tyoical pipeline was Claude creating artifacts to "test" various gameplay elements until it got a final approval from me.  
  
Courses (Claude-written Blender tools): a routing plan goes in (tees, fairway lines, greens, hazards), Codex (see below) created reference courses as an image, a playable 3D course comes out, baked into tiles the game streams per hole. 12 courses, 120 holes. Bots play every hole from two tees (easy and hard difficulty).  
  
2D art (oAI Imagegen / Codex): the course and all hole pictures in the menus have been generated by oAI ImageGen, connected to my Claude Code via its own . The 3D courses come from the Blender tools above.  
  
Audio (Elevenlabs): some sound effects and music, and the trailer narration.  
  
Distribution: Carte blanche for Meta Ads & Apple App Store Management, prepped every video, scheduled all social activities, manages all ads and releases.  
  
What AI was bad at: judging whether something looks right, and keeping the big picture across weeks without written notes. And prioritizing Speed vs. Quality.   
  
The game: four courses free with no ads, one purchase for the other eight ($2.99 at launch until 29 Nov).

Feel free to check it out in the App Store. I will also share a couple of more gameplay trailers in the comments below.   


Ask anything about the pipeline and I would love to hear what you think about the setup.
